100% pure veg Indian food in Phu Quoc. Under $30 a head. 4.9 stars from 258 reviews.

Maharaja Lounge in Sunset Town is the real deal for vegetarians who are tired of picking around a menu. Authentic curries, no meat on the premises, and a 4.9 that holds across 258 reviews.

Right beside Starbucks in Sunset Town, An Thới. Easy to find, hard to leave.
